items.title: 5.13.1 General properties of liquid crystals (liquid crystals ki aam properties) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13.1, printed page 112.

blocks.text: Liquid crystals ki aam properties yeh hain:

items: parallel ordered arrangement (seedhi qatar wali tarteeb) rakhte hain.
lambe, rod jaise aur seedhe (linear) hote hain.
liquids ki tarah behte (flow karte) hain.
liquids ki tarah viscosity dikhate hain.
crystals ki tarah optical properties (roshni se related properties) dikhate hain.
kuch had tak rigid (sakht) hote hain.
hamesha anisotropic hote hain (properties direction par depend karti hain).

blocks.caption: Liquid crystal kis mein liquid jaisa, kis mein solid jaisa

items: Liquid crystals: parallel ordered, rod jaise linear molecules; liquid ki tarah behna aur viscosity; crystal ki tarah optical properties; kuch had tak rigid; hamesha anisotropic.
